participation.context: Named the distance, put the other thing out, and stayed in the lodging.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Mentioned only as the other thing. She was not named.
participation.name: the lady of the parish

story.body: You spoke from the west window, and you did not go down to the gate.

title: Saw the oriel of Crosby Place dark

participation.context: Made the mark and shut the almanac.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set one cross on the leaf and left it without a name.

title: Put a small cross in the almanac
